configuration.execution_boundary: parent and child pinned CPU2; one lane per physical core; four jobs maximum
configuration.selector: NOT_RUN: every physical candidate separately reported

hypothesis: At 4 MiB, reuse of repeated structure and amortization may overcome the measured 32 KiB complete-size losses; test every unchanged candidate, not only selector winners.
initial_state: empty per independent contiguous region; no training or warm-up; hashes read before all jobs so source OS cache is warm; no predictor state sharing
longer_budget_justification: 4 MiB continuous PAQ encode plus independent decode tests reuse beyond tiny screens; 1200s shared maximum, no automatic restart or full-size replacement.
matched_control: Same PAQ v216 -4 and CIXSTR1 outer framing for every candidate.
promotion_criteria: Exact independent restore for every reported candidate. A 16 MiB follow-up requires aggregate complete-size saving and at least 2 of 3 region wins; holdouts additionally require >=0.5% aggregate saving and a frozen candidate. Failed/budget-limited rows remain visible. No full enwik9 authorized.
